# Inter

- Source: https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/tag/v4.1 (`Inter-4.1.zip`, `extras/ttf/`)
- Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt` (also embedded in each font's name table)
- Bundled in `src/main/res/font/` as static TTFs, unmodified, only the weights used by
  `design/tokens.json`: 400 (`inter_regular`), 500 (`inter_medium`), 600 (`inter_semibold`),
  700 (`inter_bold`).
